observers-note: Per-platform frontmatter for the evolution sub-agents. The markdown bodies live in <name>.body.md next to this file. build.sh renders the final per-platform agent files from this metadata.

evolver.description: Evolver agent — synthesizes observations into evolution units, clusters related patterns, generates proposals for new/updated skills, agents, and commands. Also handles promotion of project-scoped units to global scope. Use when the user asks to "evolve", "synthesize learnings", or when observations have accumulated enough to warrant pattern extraction.

observer.description: Observer agent — captures session learnings as sanitized observations in the evolve system. Monitors agent actions, detects patterns, and records structured observations into the Obsidian vault. Use when an agent completes a task and needs to reflect on what worked, what failed, or what patterns emerged.
